snippet.title: Galdromeda - Official trailer
snippet.description:
Galdromeda is a turn-based RPG with space combat. Assemble a crew, each having their own unique abilities, level up, upgrade your ship and your crew's abilities, collect new outfits for your crew.

Game will be availiable on Steam.

Music: Cosmic Pack 06 - Lunar Rampage © DavidKBD
